title: Introducing the TIIS Consortium Founding Initiative
excerpt: An introduction to the vision of a connected international network for computing and information technology institutions.
imageAlt: Abstract illustration representing international academic collaboration

sections.text: The Technology and Information Institutions Consortium (TIIS Consortium) is being developed as an international academic network connecting faculties, schools, and departments in Computing and Information Technology.
A platform for sustained cooperation
The initiative aims to create practical opportunities for institutional dialogue, joint research, academic exchange, workshops, and collaboration in international scientific events.

sections.alt: Placeholder visual for the TIIS Consortium network
sections.caption: A shared platform for institutions to connect, exchange knowledge, and develop collaborations.

sections.text: From connections to collaborative action
The founding initiative invites interested academic units to contribute ideas, identify shared priorities, and help shape a sustainable framework for cooperation.

title: EIDT 2025: Laying the Groundwork for Academic Exchange
excerpt: Ho Chi Minh City Open University hosted EIDT 2025, creating a foundation for academic exchange among computing researchers and institutions.

sections.text: EIDT 2025, hosted by Ho Chi Minh City Open University (HCMCOU), was an important milestone in building connections among computing researchers and higher education institutions.
A meeting point for computing research
The conference provided an academic setting for researchers to present their work, exchange perspectives, and connect with colleagues working across computing and information technology.

sections.caption: Replace this placeholder with an official EIDT 2025 conference photograph.

sections.text: A foundation for future cooperation
The relationships and conversations fostered through academic events such as EIDT 2025 helped create momentum for continued institutional engagement and future collaborative initiatives.

title: EIDT 2026: Strengthening Collaboration Through Joint Organization
excerpt: HCMCOU and PTIT joined forces to organize EIDT 2026 and expand opportunities for academic and research exchange.

sections.text: EIDT 2026 marked a further step in institutional collaboration, with Ho Chi Minh City Open University (HCMCOU) and the Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology (PTIT) working together as conference co-organizers.
Collaboration in action

Joint organization brought together academic communities and created opportunities to share research, exchange institutional experience, and strengthen connections among computing and information technology researchers.

sections.caption: Replace this placeholder with an official EIDT 2026 event photograph.

sections.text: Beyond a single conference
The partnership illustrates how academic events can support longer-term relationships between institutions and encourage further cooperation in research, education, and international engagement.

title: SIMC 2026: Connecting Researchers Through Semantic Intelligence
excerpt: The First International Conference on Semantic Intelligence in Massive Computing brought an international research community together in Ho Chi Minh City.

sections.text: The First International Conference on Semantic Intelligence in Massive Computing (SIMC 2026), hosted by Ho Chi Minh City University of Banking (HUB), created a forum for researchers to share work and discuss emerging directions in semantic intelligence and massive computing.
Research exchange across institutions

The conference contributed to a wider pattern of academic engagement among institutions working in computing and information technology. It offered opportunities for scholarly discussion, networking, and the exchange of research perspectives.

sections.caption: Replace this placeholder with an official SIMC 2026 conference photograph.

sections.text: Continuing the conversation
TIIS aims to help sustain connections established through conferences and translate shared interests into further academic activities and institutional cooperation.

title: EIDT 2027: Continuing the Partnership with IU–VNUHCM
excerpt: HCMCOU and International University – VNUHCM are preparing the next collaborative chapter of the EIDT conference series.
imageAlt: Placeholder visual for the planned EIDT 2027 collaboration

sections.text: The EIDT 2027 collaboration is planned between Ho Chi Minh City Open University (HCMCOU) and International University – Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City (IU–VNUHCM).
Building on a growing academic network
The planned partnership continues the conference series' emphasis on academic exchange and institutional cooperation in computing and information technology.

title: Institutional Dialogue: Turning Introductions into Shared Priorities
excerpt: Regular online and in-person conversations help member institutions identify practical opportunities for cooperation.
imageAlt: Placeholder visual for an institutional networking meeting

sections.text: Institutional dialogue is a core part of the TIIS activity model. Regular online meetings and in-person visits give representatives a space to introduce their academic units, exchange priorities, and explore areas of mutual interest.
A practical meeting format
Sessions may include institutional introductions, research presentations, discussions on computing education, and focused conversations about joint activities.

sections.alt: Placeholder image for an institutional meeting
sections.caption: Use this space for photographs from future TIIS meetings and institutional visits.

sections.text: The format is designed to be flexible and inclusive, enabling institutions to participate according to their interests, capacity, and schedules.
